entries.title: Job 38:1
segments: ¶And Jehovah answered Job out of the whirlwind and said,

entries.title: Job 38:2
segments: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?

entries.title: Job 38:3
segments: Gird up now thy loins like a man; and I will demand of thee, and inform thou me.

entries.title: Job 38:4
segments: ¶Where wast thou when I founded the earth? Declare, if thou hast understanding.

entries.title: Job 38:5
segments: Who set the measures thereof--if thou knowest? or who stretched a line upon it?

entries.title: Job 38:6
segments: Whereupon were the foundations thereof sunken? or who laid its corner-stone,

entries.title: Job 38:7
segments: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

entries.title: Job 38:8
segments: And who shut up the sea with doors, when it burst forth, issuing out of the womb?

entries.title: Job 38:9
segments: When I made the cloud its garment, and thick darkness a swaddling band for it;

entries.title: Job 38:10
segments: When I cut out for it my boundary, and set bars and doors,

entries.title: Job 38:11
segments: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come and no further, and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?

entries.title: Job 38:12
segments: ¶Hast thou since thy days commanded the morning? hast thou caused the dawn to know its place,

entries.title: Job 38:13
segments: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and the wicked might be shaken out of it?

entries.title: Job 38:14
segments: It is changed like the signet-clay; and [all things] stand forth as in a garment:

entries.title: Job 38:15
segments: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the uplifted arm is broken.

entries.title: Job 38:16
segments: Hast thou entered as far as the springs of the sea? and hast thou walked in the recesses of the deep?

entries.title: Job 38:17
segments: Have the gates of death been revealed unto thee? and hast thou seen the gates of the shadow of death?

entries.title: Job 38:18
segments: Hath thine understanding compassed the breadths of the earth? Declare if thou knowest it all.

entries.title: Job 38:19
segments: Where is the way to where light dwelleth? and the darkness, where is its place,

entries.title: Job 38:20
segments: That thou shouldest take it to its bound, and that thou shouldest know the paths to its house?

entries.title: Job 38:21
segments: Thou knowest, for thou wast then born, and the number of thy days is great!

entries.title: Job 38:22
segments: Hast thou entered into the storehouses of the snow, and hast thou seen the treasuries of the hail,

entries.title: Job 38:23
segments: Which I have reserved for the time of distress, for the day of battle and war?

entries.title: Job 38:24
segments: By what way is the light parted, [and] the east wind scattered upon the earth?

entries.title: Job 38:25
segments: ¶Who hath divided a channel for the rain-flood, and a way for the thunder's flash;

entries.title: Job 38:26
segments: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no one is; on the wilderness wherein there is not a man;

entries.title: Job 38:27
segments: To satisfy the desolate and waste [ground], and to cause the sprout of the grass to spring forth?

entries.title: Job 38:28
segments: Hath the rain a father? or who begetteth the drops of dew?

entries.title: Job 38:29
segments: Out of whose womb cometh the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who bringeth it forth?

entries.title: Job 38:30
segments: When the waters lie hidden as in stone, and the face of the deep holdeth fast together.

entries.title: Job 38:31
segments: Canst thou fasten the bands of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

entries.title: Job 38:32
segments: Dost thou bring forth the constellations each in its season? or dost thou guide the Bear with her sons?

entries.title: Job 38:33
segments: Knowest thou the ordinances of the heavens? dost thou determine their rule over the earth?

entries.title: Job 38:34
segments: Dost thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that floods of waters may cover thee?

entries.title: Job 38:35
segments: Dost thou send forth lightnings that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?

entries.title: Job 38:36
segments: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the mind?

entries.title: Job 38:37
segments: Who numbereth the clouds with wisdom? or who poureth out the bottles of the heavens,

entries.title: Job 38:38
segments: When the dust runneth as into a molten mass, and the clods cleave fast together?

entries.title: Job 38:39
segments: Dost thou hunt the prey for the lioness, and dost thou satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

entries.title: Job 38:40
segments: When they crouch in [their] dens, [and] abide in the thicket to lie in wait?

entries.title: Job 38:41
segments: Who provideth for the raven his food, when his young ones cry unto *God, [and] they wander for lack of meat?
